name: cleanroom_novelty_selection_v1
selection_source: clean2023 strict protein+reaction double-cold folds 0,1,2 only
candidate_policy: Only the two strongest pre-existing fold0 internal-development configurations are retained. Enzyme-405-observed rankstrong_hard64 is not admitted merely because it performed well externally.

novelty_variant.definition: nearest other training reaction by binary DRFP Tanimoto; fold-train entities only

selection_rule: fold-wise cross-metric percentile ranking, then mean joint percentile, worst-fold percentile, and stability; Enzyme-405 is confirmatory only
post_selection_policy: Train the selected recipe on all clean2023 pairs and evaluate Enzyme-405 once. Do not alter the recipe after observing Enzyme-405.
